## Question 1 {#q1}

How do you think papers on AI for social good are reviewed? See the calls for papers of:

1. [AAAI AI for Social Impact track](https://aaai.org/aaai-24-conference/call-for-the-special-track-on-ai-for-social-impact/)
2. [IJCAI AI for Social Good track](https://ijcai-23.org/call-for-papers-ai-and-social-good/)
3. [KDD Applied Data Science track](https://kdd2024.kdd.org/applied-data-science-ads-track-call-for-papers/)

## Question 2 {#q2}

Here are the AI for Social Impact (AISI) keywords from the AAAI call for papers. What kind of papers will these keywords attract?

- AISI: Agriculture and Food
- AISI: Climate
- AISI: Computational Social Science and Humanities
- AISI: Disaster Mitigation and Response
- AISI: Education
- AISI: Energy
- AISI: Environmental Sustainability
- AISI: Low and Middle-Income Countries / Underserved Communities
- AISI: Mobility / Transportation
- AISI: Natural Sciences
- AISI: Philosophical and Ethical Issues
- AISI: Public Health
- AISI: Security and Privacy
- AISI: Social Development
- AISI: Social Networks and Social Media
- AISI: Social Welfare, Justice, Fairness and Equality
- AISI: Urban Planning
- AISI: Other Social Impact

## Exercise 3 {#e3}

Read the abstracts of some best paper award winners from the AI for social impact tracks of top conferences such as AAAI, IJCAI, KDD, NeurIPS and ICLR:

1. [ActiveRemediation: The Search for Lead Pipes in Flint, Michigan](https://www.kdd.org/kdd2018/accepted-papers/view/activeremediation-the-search-for-lead-pipes-in-flint-michigan) ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YbIn_axYu9E)), KDD 2018
2. [Developing Measures of Cognitive Impairment in the Real World](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/developing-measures-of-cognitive-impairment-in-the-real-world-from-consumer-grade-multimodal-sensor-streams) ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H_wTI4LUW7A)), KDD 2019
3. [DISCount: Counting in Large Image Collections with Detector-Based Importance Sampling](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/30235), AAAI 2024

## Exercise 4 {#e4}

Read the abstracts of some papers from the AI for Social Impact track and score them on the AAAI AI for Social Impact criteria.
